human_check_steps:
# Check: long-press popup starts on what a tap types (A04-canvas393)

1. Rebuild the iPhone app from Xcode (Android: `scripts/build-android-app.sh install`).
2. Type nihao, pick 你好. Hold m: the popup opens with ？ (全角) selected; lift: ？ is typed.
3. Type hello and Space. Hold m: ? (半角) is selected; lift: ? is typed.
4. Hold a key and wiggle the finger slightly: the selection stays; slide clearly sideways: it follows the finger.
5. After Chinese the period key shows 。: hold it: the popup shows ? ？ and . ; slide to . and lift: . is typed. After English it shows . and offers 。 instead.
title: Phone keyboards: holding a key opens its popup on the form a tap would type now (全角 after Chinese or Japanese, 半角 after English)
without_human_check: iOS UI tests pass 10/10 (new test: ？ after Chinese, ? after English, . from the period popup); Android builds; the person checks on the phones
